 Feyenoord will be without Jordan Bos, Jakub Moder, Tijme Wessels, Gijs Smal, Thomas Beelen and Anis Hadj Moussa through injury. That leaves Van Bronckhorst with a considerably depleted squad. The home side have no reported suspensions.
 Marlon van de Wetering is the only Excelsior Rotterdam player ruled out through injury, leaving coach Ruben den Uil with an otherwise full squad. Further updates are expected as the match approaches.

Their latest outing ended in a 5-3 Eredivisie defeat to sc Heerenveen, after a 0-3 Champions League loss to Inter Milan. Across those five games, Feyenoord scored seven goals and conceded nine.
 Excelsior Rotterdam have lost four of their last five matches, most recently going down 1-0 to Go Ahead Eagles. A 9-0 home defeat to FC Twente in the Eredivisie was their heaviest loss in that run. Their only win came in a cup match against MVV Maastricht (0-3). Excelsior scored just once and conceded 14 goals across the five games.
